title: Denied with a note
support_note: A push no grant or working-set entry covers whole files one request for the whole push: internal/gitbroker/approval.go askForPush, which builds the About with pushAbout and the request with pushRequest (approvalauthority.go). The denial is `yolo approve <id> --deny --note <text>`; the request object is the request-decided event of `--watch --json`.
story: The human denies a push and tells the agent why; the request ends denied.
